Chemistry 2007-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2007-II.question: The flavour of apple is mainly due to which one of the following?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (c)  The flavour of apples is mainly due to the ethanol (C2H5OH).

Chemistry 2007-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2007-II.question: Nail varnish remover generally contains which one of the following?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (d)  Nail varnish remover generally contains acetone (CH3COCH3).

Chemistry 2007-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2007-II.question: In which categories did Marie Curie win her two different Nobel prizes?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (a)  Marie Curie win her two different Noble prizes in two different category i.e., Physics and Chemistry for the discovery of radium and polonium.

Chemistry 2007-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2007-II.question: 'Freon' used as refrigerants is chemically known as
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (c)  Chlorofluoro carbon (CF2Cl2) is also known as freon. It is used as refrigerants in refrigerators and air conditions. It is also used as propellant in aerosols and foams.

Chemistry 2007-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2007-II.question: German silver is an alloy of
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (d)  German silver is an alloy of copper (25-50%), zinc (25-35%) and nickel (10-35%). It is used in utensils and resistance wire.

Chemistry 2007-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2007-II.question: The tracking of people by trained dogs is based on the recognisation of which of the following compounds in the sweat from feet?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (a)  The tracking of people by trained dogs is based on the recognisation of carboxylic acid in the sweat from feet.

Chemistry 2007-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2007-II.question: Which of the following metals are present in haemoglobin and chlorophyll, respectively?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (a)  Fe and Mg metals are present in haemoglobin and chlorophyll respectively.

Chemistry 2007-II.question: Which of the following isotopes of carbon is/are used in carbon dating?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (c)  The isotope of carbon 6C14 is used in radio carbon dating.

Chemistry 2007-II.question: An a-particle consvists of which of the following?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (a)  An a-particle is identical with helium nuclei. It consists of 2 protons and 2 neutrons and represented by 2He4.

Chemistry 2007-II.question: What is the purpose of adding baking soda to dough?
Chemistry 2007-II.explanation: (d)  Baking soda has sodium bicarbonate as the chief constituent. It decomposes on heating giving carbon dioxide. This causes dough, cakes, biscuits etc. to expand and become light.
